Smallest common multiple of 10 and 15, e.g. for adding $\frac1{10}+\frac1{15}$

wolfram.note: Wolfram's Range is a List and LCM is Listable, so LCM[Range[1, 10]] threads over the elements; ours reads a lazy Range as the argument list (the maintainer's convention, pinned by the lazy-range row), so the value is Ln 2520.

caption: $\gcd(a,b)\cdot\mathrm{lcm}(a,b)=ab$. See [[GCD]]

wolfram.note: The same Range-versus-List split: ours reduces LCM(Range(1, 4)) to 12 and LCM(Range(1, 5)) to 60, so the product is Ln 5; Wolfram threads both ranges and multiplies lists of unequal length.
